Lake Vagula (Estonian: Vagula järv) is a lake in Estonia. It is located in the village of Vagula in Võru Parish, Võru County.


== Physical description ==
The lake has an area of 602.7 hectares (1,489 acres), and it has one islands with an area of 0.09 hectares (0.22 acres). The lake has an average depth of 5.3 meters (17 ft) and a maximum depth of 11.5 meters (38 ft). It is 4,930 meters (16,170 ft) long, and its shoreline measures 16,100 meters (52,800 ft). It has a volume of 33,939,000 cubic meters (1.1985×109 cu ft).
